name: Fold-free human-closed 3-RUS truss: three scapula crank hubs, O5 rods to arm ball studs, the user's GH closes the loop
lens: deployable structures / overconstrained and spherical linkage kinematics
family: human-closed RUS truss (spherical parallel mechanism on the user's GH)
verdict: KILLED after the coarse screen: 5 honest full-model configurations seeded from the fold-free legs take no pose (gap 275.0), the red-team ceiling with every part-part collision OFF is 253.41 (reach 0.34, in-band 0.18, contact 0.53) vs the leader 26.34 fast / 33.84 frozen exact. The fold lever works PER LEG (leg-fold theorem: each RUS leg closed by GH is a spherical RRR with its own band; 188/280 seat-stud pairs fold-free, legs valid 0.93-0.98 in the model) but the truss dies on crank parking, the parallel singularity and part count
limiter: (1) crank parking: a fold-free leg needs a 60-85 deg crank whose circle about a scapula-fixed axis sweeps the raised / extended arm (mid-span need p90 105-130 mm vs seat skin 93-102; tip p50 55-62) or the trunk on the other branch (need >= 160 mm) - fitted cranks end at the 220 mm march ceiling (r_T 230) at p 100; (2) parallel singularity: fold-free studs cluster on the posterior humeral head, det >= 0.10 on only 0.675-0.80 of the workspace; (3) ~15 fitted rigid parts: base brackets cross the crank sweep (br/crank 136 of 151 poses), rods fold back over their own cranks on the trunk-free branch (32 poses)
note: Bench(60,160) fast grid (exact libigl outside the grid box), the base model's checks (K3 march, 10 fps continuity on every crank / U / ball angle, 1 mm part clearance, contact rule) on every evaluation; 500-1100 s per configuration on the shared box. Kinematic screens (docs/research/rus/): leg_bands.json 280 seat-stud pairs, crank_park.json 24 leg-branches, skew_kin.json 168 skew legs (sibling skin-normal skew-crank RSS truss killed: best leg coverage 0.58 at rho 20 vs 0.975 for a GH-centred beta-50 crank). Farm coarse sweep (240 random configs) cancelled with 7/24 chunks running (shared queue 107 jobs, failure already structural); 4 CMA streams cancelled before start; gate not applicable; no frozen Bench(110,360) wear (nothing taken). Mobility 3 (Grubler on the bench: 21 - 18), 0 passive translations, every joint a catalogue part
gate: not applicable: killed after the coarse screen

mechanism.notes: human-closed 3-RUS truss, three crank hubs on separate scapula seats joined by 2 base brackets. bodies: 3 cranks, 3 O5 Ti rods, arm saddle (arm-end, joined to BOTTOM). joints: 3 crank hubs (ACTIVE), 3 crank-tip U-joints (2 rot each, O12 housing; counted as one joint without its cross), 3 ball studs / rod ends (3 rot each). passive_rot = 3 x (2 + 3) = 15; 2 loops (three legs between the base and the saddle, the user's GH closes the chain); Grubler on the bench 3 x (1 + 2 + 3) + 3 - 18 = 3, rod spins killed by the U pitch pins. sensed 0 on the bench (the 3 crank angles fix the arm by the parallel FK); on a body GH translation enters that FK (the legs absorb it), so exact tracking would need GH's shift - not counted. custom: base, 2 base brackets, 3 cranks, 3 rods, saddle, 3 hub shafts (est.); catalogue: 3 x MR117 pair, 3 miniature U-joints, 3 rod ends, 3 ball studs (est.).
